spec_family.name: Exterior Soffit Prime and Paint
spec_family.description: Combined prime and finish for soffit (eave underside). Overhead work is the defining constraint — all rates reduced ~25-35% from vertical baselines. Spray conditional on non-vented construction (FM-001 attic vent contamination). Three substrate paths (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement HardieSoffit, vinyl). Flat to satin sheen only.

includes: Soffit field painting — all overhead eave underside surfaces
Overhead surface preparation (low-pressure wash, substrate-specific sanding, dust cleanup)
T&G groove work (brush detail for tongue-and-groove board joints)
End-seal fiber cement cut edges (FM-006 prevention)
Tannin spot-prime knots on wood soffit (cedar/redwood)
Caulk soffit panel joints and soffit-to-fascia/frieze junctions
Full field prime coat (4 substrate-driven primer paths)
Finish coat application (1-2 coats by quality tier)
Landscape and hardscape ground protection (critical for overhead drip fallout)

excludes.route_to: SF_TRIM_EXT_NC — fascia is trim scope, not soffit scope
Future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC — separate scope when porch ceiling is continuous with soffit
PROHIBITED on soffit — damages thin panel edges, strips factory primer, forces water into attic through vents (COMPAT-SFIT-010)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling coat count, inspection scrutiny, interstage sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (single finish coat on primed surfaces). QT3=standard (2 finish coats). QT4=premium (2 finish coats, interstage sand 220 grit, systematic raking light inspection). QT5 excluded — not applicable to soffit field per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats. Spray is CONDITIONAL on vent type.
configuration_dimensions.notes: brush_roll is PRIMARY default — valid for all soffit types (vented and non-vented). spray is CONDITIONAL on soffit_vent_type = non_vented. Vented soffit: brush_roll ONLY — spray drives paint into attic through perforations (FM-001 critical failure). spray_backroll NOT valid — overhead back-rolling is impractical.

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit substrate material type. Drives primer selection, prep task activation, and material compatibility rules.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Wood: T&G boards or plywood panels. Fiber cement: HardieSoffit. Vinyl: PVC panels (often unpainted; when painted, requires bonding primer and LRV restrictions).

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen level. Restricted to flat and satin for soffit surfaces.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Per Exterior_Color_Sheen_Configuration_Doctrine §3: soffits use flat or satin. No semi-gloss or gloss — overhead surfaces show imperfections at higher sheen. Flat is the most common soffit sheen.

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit vent construction type. Critical gate for spray eligibility.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Vented: continuous perforated panels or individual strip/circular vents — spray PROHIBITED (FM-001). Non-vented: solid panels/boards — spray eligible. Default assumption: vented (forces brush/roll as safe default).

configuration_dimensions.description: Soffit panel/board construction type. Drives T&G joint complexity modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: T&G boards have ~20% higher labor due to joint complexity (FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS). Solid panels (plywood, fiber cement, vinyl) have smooth surface — no joint penalty.

paintable_items.name: Exterior soffit field surface
paintable_items.counting_rules: Net paintable soffit field area in square feet. Eave depth x roofline perimeter length. Measured per elevation. Excludes vent openings on perforated panels.
paintable_items.notes: Single paintable item — covers all soffit substrate types (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement, vinyl). SF-based like siding, not LF-based like trim.

valid_input_states.notes: SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD: bare wood T&G or plywood soffit — also used by convention for vinyl soffit (no dedicated SS_EXT_BARE_VINYL exists) and bare/damaged fiber cement. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY: fiber cement soffit with factory transit primer — field prime MANDATORY. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD: any substrate already field-primed — skip prime module entirely.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen configuration. Flat is the most common soffit sheen.

material_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Primer for Wood/FC Soffit
material_systems.notes: Standard 100% acrylic exterior primer for (1) bare wood soffit — full field prime, (2) factory-primed fiber cement — field prime MANDATORY per Hardie warranty. Overhead application increases waste ~10%.

material_systems.name: Alkyd/Shellac Spot Primer for Tannin Knots on Wood Soffit
material_systems.notes: Spot-applied to visible knots on tannin-rich species (cedar, redwood, Douglas fir) BEFORE full acrylic primer. Not a full-surface system. Prevents tannin bleed-through — brown staining most visible on flat white soffit finish.

material_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement Soffit
material_systems.notes: Required for bare/damaged fiber cement soffit (pH 13.0). Prevents saponification. Reference product: SW Loxon Masonry Primer. Bare FC uses SS_EXT_BARE_WOOD by convention when factory primer is absent/damaged.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Vinyl Soffit
material_systems.notes: Mandatory bonding/adhesion primer for non-porous vinyl soffit (Insl-X STIX, BM Fresh Start). Chemical bond to PVC surface. Recoat within 1 week (RISK-SFIT-008). Only 100% acrylic latex binders compatible.

material_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
material_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior with mildewcide. Flat to satin. QT2: single coat. QT3: 2 coats. Mildew-resistant formulation recommended for sheltered soffit.

material_systems.name: Premium Exterior Acrylic Soffit Paint
material_systems.notes: Premium materials (SW Emerald, BM Aura). 2 finish coats. Light sand between coats (220 grit). Mildew-resistant formulation critical for sheltered soffit.

material_systems.name: Solar-Reflective Paint for Vinyl Soffit
material_systems.notes: CONDITIONAL: required when vinyl substrate AND color LRV < 55. VinylSafe/IR-reflective technology prevents thermal distortion (FM-005). HARD STOP — standard dark paint on vinyl causes warping at ~165°F. Only 100% acrylic latex binders.

production_summary.overhead_rate_design: BAKED_INTO_BASE_RATES — all rates already include ~25-35% overhead penalty from vertical baselines. FAC_SFIT_OVERHEAD (1.35) is NOT applied as a stacking modifier.

factor_modifiers.name: Access Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.applies_to: 26 overhead tasks (all except ground-level protection setup, equipment setup, cleanup)
factor_modifiers.notes: Stacks ON TOP of overhead-adjusted base rates.

factor_modifiers.name: Vented Soffit Application Penalty
factor_modifiers.notes: Only brush/roll — spray is PROHIBITED on vented soffit.

factor_modifiers.name: Tongue-and-Groove Joint Complexity Modifier
factor_modifiers.applies_to: Brush/roll application and wood sand prep tasks
factor_modifiers.notes: T&G brush-back tasks (TSK_SFIT_TG_BRUSH_BACK_1/2) already reflect groove work — do NOT apply this modifier to those.

modifier_stacking.worst_case_scenario: Vented T&G board soffit, scaffold access: FAC_SFIT_VENT_COMPLEXITY(1.15) x FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS(1.20) x FAC_EXT_ACCESS(1.60) = 2.208x
modifier_stacking.worst_case_effective_rate: 54 SF/hr brush/roll finish — slow but expected for overhead vented T&G from scaffold

variants.notes: Economy brush/roll on bare/factory-primed soffit. Single finish coat.
Standard brush/roll on bare/factory-primed soffit. Two finish coats.
Premium brush/roll on bare/factory-primed soffit. Interstage sand. Systematic inspection.
Standard spray on non-vented solid panel soffit. Full protection scope for overspray.
Premium spray on non-vented soffit. Interstage sand. Systematic inspection.
Economy on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Single finish coat. Minimum viable scope.
Standard on field-primed surface. Skip prime. Two finish coats.
Vinyl soffit. Bonding primer mandatory. Solar-reflective finish if LRV < 55. Scuff-sand prep required.

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Net paintable soffit field area (eave depth x roofline perimeter)
Number of building elevations in scope
Access type per elevation (ground/ladder/scaffold/lift) — drives FAC_EXT_ACCESS height modifier
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec.
Soffit vent construction type (vented/non_vented). Gates spray eligibility. Default: vented.
Soffit panel/board construction type (solid_panel/tg_board). Drives FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS modifier.

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When landscape is below soffit work zone
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Landscape area directly below soffit requiring ground protection

required_paintscope_inputs.required_when: When walkways are below soffit work zone
required_paintscope_inputs.description: Walkway/hardscape area below soffit requiring protection
Count of soffit-mounted light fixtures to mask (recessed lights, porch fixtures)

protection_zones_required.notes: SF-based landscape area directly below soffit drip zone. CRITICAL for overhead work — gravity pulls all drips straight down. Brush/roll: drop cloth at base. Spray: full tarp over entire drip zone.
Walkway/hardscape below soffit. Canvas drop cloths for non-slip crew traffic.
Soffit-mounted fixtures — recessed lights, porch fixtures. Bag or tape over. Remove cover plate if accessible.
Fascia board above soffit — tape + 12-inch masking film at fascia-soffit junction when fascia is already painted. Skip in top-down NC sequence when fascia is unfinished.
Siding below soffit at wall junction (frieze area) — protect when siding is already painted. Typically unfinished in top-down NC sequence.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Fascia above soffit. Trim color. Separate scope (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC). Cut-in required at junction.
Frieze board at soffit-to-wall junction. Trim color. Separate scope.
Corner boards at gable soffit termination. Trim color.
Siding below soffit separated by frieze board. No direct soffit-to-siding cut-in needed.
Porch ceiling may be continuous with soffit (same color). Future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC.

site_condition_rules.affected_tasks: All 26 overhead tasks (see FAC_EXT_ACCESS applies_to list in production.json)
site_condition_rules.effect: ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50. Applied as time multiplier: effective_rate = base_rate / modifier.
site_condition_rules.notes: Stacks on top of overhead-adjusted base rates. Ground-level tasks (protection setup/teardown, equipment setup, cleanup) excluded.

deduplication_notes: Fascia and frieze are separate spec scope (SF_TRIM_EXT_NC). This spec handles soffit side of fascia-soffit junction. Trim spec handles the trim side.
Porch ceiling is separate scope (future SF_PORCH_CEILING_EXT_NC). Edge work at soffit-porch ceiling transition may need deduplication.
Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility — siding specs handle that.
Soffit-to-siding junction: frieze board typically separates them. No direct soffit-to-siding cut-in needed.
Top-down sequence: soffit is painted before siding body. Adjacent fascia/frieze protection depends on whether they are already finished.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 2 Finish Coats
round_configurations.description: Standard NC sequence: 1 field prime + 2 finish coats at QT3/QT4 on bare or factory-primed substrates.

round_configurations.name: Prime + 1 Finish Coat (Economy)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2: 1 field prime + 1 finish coat on bare or factory-primed substrates.

round_configurations.name: 2 Finish Coats Only (Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Skip prime, 2 finish coats for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD at QT3/QT4.

round_configurations.name: 1 Finish Coat Only (Economy, Field-Primed)
round_configurations.description: Economy QT2 single finish coat on field-primed surface. Minimum viable scope.

issues.description: TSK_SFIT_PRIME_ALKALI_BRUSH_ROLL missing application_method in production.json applies_when — added.
Environmental modifiers (wind, sun, temp) included in production factor_modifiers. Inconsistent with sibling exterior pattern but no functional impact.
Caulk task in prep module but must execute AFTER prime per COMPAT-SFIT-009. Documented in sequence_notes.

critical_risks: RISK-SFIT-001: Attic vent contamination from spray on vented soffit — mitigated by vent_type gating (FM-001)
RISK-SFIT-002: Thermal distortion on vinyl from dark paint — mitigated by solar-reflective finish (FM-005)
RISK-SFIT-003: Edge wicking on FC panels — mitigated by edge sealing task (FM-006)

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup → Prep → Prime → Finish 1 → Interstage → Finish 2 → Final Inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.edge_work: Cut-in at fascia-soffit and frieze-soffit junctions. Required for both brush/roll and spray methods.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Ground protection (landscape/hardscape) → Fixture masking → Fascia masking (when finished) → Equipment setup → Coating work → Protection teardown → Equipment cleanup → Site cleanup
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (substrate-specific) → Prime (1 coat, skipped for SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD) → Finish coat 1 → Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, touch up) → Finish coat 2 (QT3/QT4) → Final inspect → Touch up
sequencing_notes.elevation_strategy: Work one elevation at a time to minimize protection setup/teardown cycles.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO spray on vented soffit. NO power washing. NO semi-gloss or gloss sheen. NO alkyd/oil binders on vinyl.

relationships.cross_spec_protection_note: Fascia/frieze protection during soffit work is this spec's responsibility when those surfaces are already finished. Window/door protection is siding spec's responsibility.
relationships.notes: First exterior overhead field-surface spec. Shares protection zones and access modifiers with siding siblings. Key departures: overhead-adjusted base rates, spray vent-type gating, T&G groove brush-back tasks, extension pole as primary tool, 4 primer paths, flat/satin sheen only.

sections_used: No spray on vented soffit Part A §6

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior soffit prime and paint (new construction). First exterior overhead field-surface spec. Combined prime+paint (single mobilization). Key features: overhead-adjusted base rates (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines), spray eligibility gated by soffit_vent_type (FM-001), 3 substrate paths (wood T&G/plywood, fiber cement HardieSoffit, vinyl), 4 primer systems (acrylic/tannin spot/alkali-resistant/bonding) + 2 finish systems + 1 conditional solar-reflective, 6 configuration dimensions (quality_tier QT2-QT4, application_method, substrate_material, sheen flat/satin, soffit_vent_type, soffit_panel_type), 37 tasks across 8 modules (29 binary + 6 qt_scaled + 2 qt_conditional), 5 protection zones, 3 stacking modifiers (access/vent complexity/T&G joints, max 2.208x). QA result: pass (3 minor issues, 1 resolved, 2 acknowledged).
